highlights.title: Items from receipt mails
highlights.detail: A transaction with a receipt mail now shows the items, discounts, fees and total from the mail as a receipt, under the link to Gmail. The app shows only items that add up to a total in the mail or to the card charge, so it does not guess. A mail in another currency shows its currency next to the total. These items also show on the Items page, without shipping, fees and VAT.
